name: plc_online_browse
description: List variables in the connected PLC with their data types: data block members ('DB_Name.Member.Sub'), inputs, outputs and memory. An array of a simple type is one row with its bounds in 'array'; read it whole by name or one element as 'Name[3]'. The full list is read once and cached until refresh is true; filter narrows it by name text. Use the names with plc_online_read_tags.

filter.description: Optional case-insensitive text the variable name must contain, e.g. 'DB_Process.' or 'Speed'.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging. Default 0.

refresh.description: Browse the PLC again instead of using the cached list (after a download). Default false.
